title: Check that DESCRIPTION's Description field is a full paragraph — cl_check_description_length

what: Check for writes to enclosing/global environments via <<- or ->> — cl_check_global_env_write
title: Check for writes to enclosing/global environments via <<- or ->> — cl_check_global_env_write
text: Flags <<-/->> usage R/. operator writes nearest enclosing environment existing binding name, .GlobalEnv none exists – CRAN Repository Policy explicitly forbids. Package code uses <<- update variable known parent scope (e.g. closure factory) technically safe, check distinguish case accidental global write without deeper scope analysis, every use flagged review.

what: Check for hardcoded random seeds in package code — cl_check_hardcoded_seed
title: Check for hardcoded random seeds in package code — cl_check_hardcoded_seed
text: Flags set.seed() calls R/ pass literal, unchangeable number (e.g. set.seed(42), set.seed(seed = 42L), set.seed(-5)) argument. Setting seed user override opt , inside function, common CRAN rejection reason. Calls tests/, \examples, vignettes/, demos scope – scanned , since checks look R/ – setting seed expected recommended reproducibility.

title: Check for calls to installed.packages() — cl_check_installed_packages
text: Flags call installed.packages() R/. Per CRAN Cookbook, function can slow (reads several files per installed package) used test whether package available; requireNamespace()/require() recommended replacements (find.package()/system.file() locate one, packageDescription() details small number packages).
